vedic_reference.note: Simran is a common name in Hinduism, and it is derived from the Sanskrit word 'simrana', which means 'recollection' or 'remembrance'. In Hindu mythology, Simran is associated with the goddess Parvati, who is believed to be the embodiment of love, compassion, and devotion. It is also a name used in various Hindu scriptures and texts.
